routes.note: The Reels tab, a single reel, a profile's Reels tab, and a reel opened from a profile. URLs are the most stable thing Instagram has. Usernames can't contain '/', so '/reelsfan/' is not matched.
Stories and highlights open under /stories/. This works even when the tray selector misses.
The full-page 'Suggested for you' list behind 'See all'.
Instagram's own chronological Following feed. If Instagram drops the parameter, the normal feed shows; nothing breaks.

hide.note: 'Open in app' and 'Get the app' buttons, matched by where they link rather than by class names.
Bottom-nav Reels tab and the Reels tab on profiles, matched by link target. The aria-label fallback covers icon-only links; 'Reels' is the same word in most languages.
Any link to a single reel: profile grid tiles, reel shelves, reels shared in DMs. '/reel/' (singular) only ever means a reel.

hide.label: Reel hidden by Lite Social
hide.note: Feed posts are <article> elements. A post that links to /reel/ or contains a <video> is a Reel (Instagram turned all feed videos into Reels). :has() is pure CSS, so there's no flash and no JS cost. Also catches reels opened via /p/ links.
On mobile, Explore doubles as search, so the page stays reachable and only its post tiles are hidden. Scoped to Explore paths so posts elsewhere are untouched.
Best effort: the tray has no stable link to match. Story rings are drawn with <canvas>. Scoped to the home feed. The route rule blocks opening stories even if this misses.

textHide.label: Suggestion hidden by Lite Social
textHide.note: Suggested posts are ordinary <article>s with a 'Suggested for you' label, so only text gives them away. English only for now; add translations to 'match'.
The 'Suggested for you' accounts carousel. The closest ancestor that holds both the 'See all' link (/explore/people/) and profile pictures is the whole carousel; the header row alone has no images.
